name: pd-console Story Linework Sandboxes
summary: Editorial Story Linework gallery for the static GPUI sandbox: hero, state band, and four reduced-motion study canvases.
galleryNotes: Keep this sandbox separate from production pd-console surfaces.
Reduced motion should freeze the canvases without changing layout.
Story Linework palette, micro-flags, and corner ticks remain the visual grammar.

studies.promotionGate: Rows must map to daemon-backed AgentNode/AgentRun truth, expose next action, and keep each honest state distinct.
Line claims must be receipt-backed and never imply lock strength the daemon does not enforce.
No animation may run without a deadline, retry budget, or recovery phase, and the frozen frame must still read clearly.
Theme-token uniforms, reduced-motion freeze, and headless capture required before GPUI embedding.
